official.deadline_note: The OAS announcement for Colorado State University publishes no scholarship closing date: bachelor's programmes run on rolling admission and graduate admission deadlines vary by programme, so the operative date is the deadline of the programme you are admitted to
official.application_cycle: Fall 2027 intake - CSU states that only newly admitted students for Fall 2027 will be considered at this time; listed by the OAS among its 2026 open announcements under the PAEC programme
official.status_note: CSU is taking applications from eligible newly admitted international students for Fall 2027, and the OAS announcements page lists OAS - Colorado State University (PAEC, onsite, United States, English) among its open opportunities
official.tuition_coverage_note: OAS scholarship recipients will receive 1/3 off non-resident tuition for all degree seeking on-campus program (CSU International Enrollment Center); the College of Business states Impact MBA recipients receive 1/3 off the non-resident base tuition per semester
benefits: 1/3 off non-resident tuition for all degree seeking on-campus programs
No application fee for OAS applicants (Impact MBA)
For the Impact MBA, eligibility for OAS scholarships in addition to other scholarships and fellowships to offset the cost of tuition
eligibility: Must be admitted to a degree-seeking, on-campus program at Colorado State University's Fort Collins campus; only newly admitted students for Fall 2027 will be considered at this time
Students admitted to the SPUR campus are not eligible, as they already pay discounted tuition
New, first-year students are not eligible; only transfer undergraduate or graduate students are considered
Only citizens of the 32 OAS member economies listed on the page are eligible to apply
Students awarded a full assistantship by their department are not eligible for the OAS scholarship
U.S. citizens and permanent residents, including those holding dual U.S. citizenship and citizenship of a member economy country, are not eligible

Graduate applicants must be a citizen or permanent resident of an OAS Member State, hold a first university (bachelor's) degree by the time of application to the scholarship, have a GPA above the minimum standard required by the university, possess the language competence to undertake studies in the language of the institution in the country of study, and be in good physical and mental health

Undergraduate applicants must be a citizen or permanent resident of an OAS Member State, have completed the first two years of the undergraduate degree or hold an Associate's degree, have a GPA above the minimum standard required by the university, possess the language competence to undertake studies in the language of the institution in the country of study, and be in good physical and mental health
requirements: Admission to a degree-seeking, on-campus program at the Fort Collins campus for Fall 2027
Completion of the brief OAS Scholarship Application - Colorado State University on the International Enrollment Center page
Answers to the eligibility screening questions: new Fall 2027 student status, student type, OAS member-state citizenship, and dual U.S. citizenship or permanent residency
Name, preferred first name, email, CSU ID, date of birth and mailing address
Two essay responses of 2-3 paragraphs each: why you chose to apply to Colorado State University, and your career goals and how a CSU degree would help you reach them
Impact MBA applicants apply after acceptance into the programme, which starts annually in August
documents: CSU ID issued when the CSU application account was created (available in RamWeb)
Evidence of admission to a degree-seeking on-campus programme (implied by the admission screening question and the newly-admitted rule)
Two essay responses typed into the OAS Scholarship Application form
Contact and mailing address details as requested by the form
selection_criteria: GPA above the minimum standard required by the university
Essay responses on motivation for CSU and career goals
Published rule: students who qualify for both the OAS Scholarship and the APEC scholarship can receive only one award and will receive the higher of the two
coverage: One third off non-resident tuition for degree-seeking on-campus programmes at the Fort Collins campus
Impact MBA: 1/3 off the non-resident base tuition per semester
application_method: Apply to and be admitted by Colorado State University Fort Collins for Fall 2027

Complete the 'OAS Scholarship Application - Colorado State University' form on the International Enrollment Center page, including the eligibility screening questions, contact details, CSU ID and the two essays
Contact international@colostate.edu for more information about applying
Impact MBA applicants request information through the College of Business and apply after acceptance
official.application_route: Gain admission to CSU Fort Collins first, then submit the embedded OAS Scholarship Application form on the CSU International Enrollment Center page
official.study_mode: On-site, on-campus degree study at the Fort Collins campus (the OAS announcement lists the modality as onsite, United States)
official.citizenship_residency: Citizens of the 32 OAS member economies listed by CSU (including Canada and the Latin American and Caribbean member states, excluding the United States); the published criteria also refer to citizens or permanent residents of an OAS Member State, while U.S. citizens and permanent residents, including dual holders, are excluded
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is restricted to non-U.S. citizens of OAS member economies; U.S. citizens and permanent residents are explicitly ineligible
official.duration: Follows the length of the degree programme pursued; the Impact MBA starts annually in August
official.description: In partnership with the Organization of American States, Colorado State University offers scholarships to qualified candidates of the Americas to participate in on-campus academic programs at CSU, awarded as one third off non-resident tuition for all degree-seeking on-campus programs.
official.region: United States (Fort Collins, Colorado); OAS region of the Americas
official.program_type: OAS Partnerships Program for Education and Training (PAEC) partner-institution scholarship at a host university
official.english_requirement: Possess the language competence to undertake studies in the language of the institution in country of study (published wording; no specific test, score or MOI rule is stated)

verification.notes: Read the CSU International Enrollment Center OAS page, the OAS 2026 announcements page, the College of Business Impact MBA OAS page and the ISSS estimated-expenses page; the benefit is published only as a one-third reduction of non-resident tuition, so no absolute figure, currency or stipend exists to record

applicant_utility.summary: This is a tuition discount, not a funded studentship: one third comes off your non-resident tuition bill, and you still carry the rest of the tuition plus every living cost. Nothing is paid until you are admitted to a Fort Collins on-campus degree programme for Fall 2027, so the CSU admission application is the real first step. First-year undergraduates and anyone on the SPUR campus are screened out by design, and the same form rejects applicants who hold a full departmental assistantship. Treat it as a discount that stacks on top of other scholarships you win separately, and budget for the uncovered two-thirds from day one.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Transfer undergraduates and master's, doctoral or Impact MBA students from the 32 OAS member economies who are already admitted to a Fort Collins on-campus programme and have no departmental assistantship.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply for CSU admission first and secure a Fall 2027 offer, since the OAS form is only open to newly admitted students
Locate your CSU ID in RamWeb before opening the form - the application account must already exist for the ID to be issued
Draft both essays offline (why CSU, and career goals, 2-3 paragraphs each) and paste them in, keeping a local copy in case the form session drops
Verify your country appears on the published 32-economy member list and that you hold no U.S. permanent residence or dual U.S. citizenship
Check whether you also qualify for the APEC scholarship, since only the higher of the two awards is paid
Model the true cost before committing: CSU's ISSS estimated-expenses figures are the basis U.S. visa documents are issued against
common_rejection_risks: Being a new first-year undergraduate - those students are covered by CSU's automatic-consideration international scholarships instead and are explicitly excluded here
Holding U.S. permanent residence or dual U.S. citizenship alongside OAS citizenship, which is an outright bar
Being admitted to the SPUR campus programme, whose already-discounted tuition disqualifies you
Holding a full departmental assistantship, or expecting to combine the OAS discount with a graduate assistantship
Submitting the OAS form before the CSU admission decision, or as a continuing student rather than a newly admitted one
Answering the screening questions inconsistently with the programme type or citizenship you later select
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining two-thirds of non-resident tuition and required fees, all living expenses, health insurance and travel. CSU's ISSS estimates 2026-27 international costs at $62,186 total for undergraduates ($38,176 non-resident tuition and required fees, $18,472 living expenses, $5,538 other including $2,556 health insurance) and $57,357 for standard graduate programmes; a one-third reduction of that undergraduate tuition figure is worth roughly $12,700 a year, and roughly $15,700 for the $47,152 Impact MBA.
document_audit: The form asks only for your CSU ID, contact details and two essays - no transcripts or test scores are uploaded, because your admission file is the evidence
The email you give must be the primary address on your CSU application, or the office cannot match the submission to your admission
The mailing-address country list is very long; make sure it is consistent with the OAS country of citizenship you select
The essays are typed directly into the web form with no upload, so a dropped session can lose the text - compose elsewhere and paste
Impact MBA applicants request information through the College of Business form rather than the general OAS form route
alerts: No scholarship closing date is published: bachelor's admission is rolling and graduate deadlines vary by programme, so your effective deadline is the admission deadline of the specific programme you apply to
The discount is applied per semester against the then-current non-resident base tuition, so a mid-degree tuition increase raises both your bill and the value of the cut
If you qualify for both the OAS and APEC scholarships you will receive only one award - the higher of the two - so applying to both does not stack
The reduction touches non-resident tuition only, so admitted students who would already pay lower resident-style rates gain little
For the Impact MBA, eligibility begins only after acceptance into the programme, which starts annually in August
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Be admitted to a Fort Collins on-campus degree programme for Fall 2027, then complete the embedded OAS Scholarship Application form on the CSU International Enrollment Center page and email international@colostate.edu with any questions.
